entries.note: Rigid glass growing hall: sawtooth glazed ridges over hydroponic crop rows under lit grow-light bars, header pipe north, door east. Covered farm on a hostile world; walk-in, no cover.
The glass hall half as long, to end a row or fill a short plot.
Boiler and CO2 house: flue stack and CO2 tank, header pipe, ending a hall row.

note: A covered farm look for hostile worlds (story-map-pools.md, Planet skin; PlanetSkin.FarmLook), one of three put to the owner after the polytunnels did not read as hydroponics. Measured 1448x1086 RGBA, three alpha pieces. Geometry-first reskin of templates/glasshouses-guide.png (hydroponics-guide.py, 125 px a cell); ImageGen returned the sheet uniformly at 0.943 of the guide and every piece within a few pixels of its guide, so each rect is its guide frame at that scale. Exact prompt in glasshouses.prompt.txt.
